_status: Timing, IDs and links are from a real NASA DONKI event. DOSE RATES ARE SIMULATED (shape only, not measured).
dose_note: dose simulated; timing from real DONKI event

source.name: NASA DONKI (Space Weather Database Of Notifications, Knowledge, Information)

replay.note: The demo replays the event compressed into 20 minutes.

dose_curve_note: Reference curve for the ISS (mSv/h), dose simulated; timing from real DONKI event. Multiplied by location_scale per location.

location_scale._note: DRAFT - Yenna reviews. Multiplier on the reference (ISS) dose curve. Simulated, not measured.

location_reason.iss: Earth's magnetic field turns most of the particles away from the ISS.
location_reason.moon: No magnetic field on the Moon; the ground blocks only the half of the sky below you.
location_reason.rover:moon: No magnetic field on the Moon, and the rover cabin is thinner than the base walls.
location_reason.mars: Deep space: no magnetic field and no planet to block the particles. The biggest effect.
location_reason.rover:mars: The thin Martian air and the planet block part of the particles, but no magnetic field protects you.
location_reason.default: Effect depends on the shielding where you are.

alert: Solar particle event: go to the shielded area

advice.iss: Go to the most shielded module now and stay there until the event ends. Tell your crew.
advice.moon: Go to the base shelter now and stay inside until the event ends. Stop surface activity.
advice.mars: Go to the storm shelter (the water-wall area) now and stay there until the event ends.
advice.rover: DRAFT: Drive back to the base shelter now. If you cannot reach it in time, stay inside the rover cabin and tell the base crew.
advice.default: Go to the most shielded area now and stay there until the event ends.
